summary: Luebo territory (Kasaï) comprises Luebo and Ndjoko-Mpunda secteurs. It was affected by the Kamuina Nsapu insurgency in 2016-2017 (including attacks on Luebo town), but militias were defeated or demobilised by 2018-2019 and no armed group is known to hold territory as of 2026. The towns of Luebo and Ndjoko-Mpunda are policed by the PNC with FARDC and ANR present; rural areas fall under PNC posts and customary chiefs. Assessment relies on background knowledge because live web research was unavailable in this run, so confidence is limited.

zones.description: Main towns: Luebo (territory seat) with Kasenga, and Ndjoko-Mpunda (CMCO, Ndombi, Port Kasai) on the Kasai river
zones.evidence: Administrative centres with territorial administration, PNC commissariats and FARDC/ANR presence. Luebo was attacked by Kamuina Nsapu militias in 2017 but the state regained it in 2017 and no armed group has held the towns since.
